title: x64 builds ship the x86 Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI.dll, breaking all SQL connections
author: eran132
body_snippet:
## Summary

In an x64 framework-dependent build, `Assemblies\Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI.dll` is the **x86** binary (PE machine `0x14c`). Any SQL Server connection therefore fails as soon as the driver initializes:

```
System.TypeInitializationException: The type initializer for 'Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.TdsParser' threw an exception.
 ---> System.TypeInitializationException: The type initializer for 'Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNILoadHandle' threw an exception.
 ---> System.BadImageFormatExcept...
